test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them contains an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options.

After months of / meticulous planning and hard work, / a team successfully launched / their innovative product to the market.

options.text: their innovative product to the market.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error in the sentence lies in the use of the pronoun "**their**"
